verdict.rationale: Flagright's marketing page claims watchlist screening with "fully configurable matching algorithms," which covers the configuration half of the story, but only as a single thin claim. Nothing in the pack shows how matching is configured or that analysts can inspect alias or transliteration matches. missing for 10: documented name-matching configuration (fuzziness thresholds, algorithm options), alias match inspection, transliteration match inspection, match-detail views or API fields, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can configure name matching and inspect alias or transliteration matches

citations.quote: Watchlist Screening - Screen with fully configurable matching algorithms.
